children: Hadron Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: HDRN) (“Hadron” or the “Company”), an advanced nuclear technology company developing the 10-megawatt electric (10MWe) Halo Micro-Modular Reactor (MMR), today announced that it will participate in the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, being held September 14–16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel in New York City.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:

A live webcast of the presentation can be accessed on the investor relations section of the Hadron’s website. A replay of the webcast will be archived and available following the event for approximately 90 days.

Hadron’s Founder and Chief Executive Officer Samuel Gibson, Head of Reactor Licensing Andrea Veil, and Chief Nuclear Officer Ross Ridenoure, will be available for one-on-one meetings with institutional investors throughout the conference.
Investors interested in meeting with Hadron’s management team should contact their H.C. Wainwright representative. To register for the conference, click below:

Hadron Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: HDRN) is an advanced nuclear technology company focused on developing the Halo Micro-Modular Reactor (MMR), a 10 megawatt-electric factory-manufactured, transportable light-water reactor. Engineered to deliver continuous, emission-free baseload power and heat with a multi-year refueling cycle, Hadron aims to meet growing demand for clean, scalable, and rapidly deployable energy. As an integrated designer, manufacturer, and owner-operator, the Company is dedicated to powering data centers, industrial and heavy-manufacturing facilities, remote communities, and grid stabilization. For more information, visit www.hadronenergy.com.
